messages:
alex: Heads-up: scheduling Console frontend deploy 21:00 UTC (today). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/frontend/pull/4021 landed to canary. This includes canvas caching tweaks and new asset fingerprinting. Need CDN invalidation plan and someone to run smoke checks. ETA ~15m for canary. @rachel @sam any chance to cover rollback/readiness?

rachel: I can be on smoke for the first 30m after deploy. Will run profile and search flows. Any specific smoke checklist to follow?

sam: I can handle CDN invalidation + cache headers. Plan: invalidate /console/* and prime /console/main.*.js. I will submit the invalidate and post the ID. After purge, will run a small pre-warm curl loop.

mira: Are we doing staged canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%)? If so keep at 5% for 10m and watch errors + p95.

alex: Yes staged: 5% for 10m, 25% for 10m, then 100%. Deploy-bot will handle rollouts. Rollback criteria: errors >1% or p95 latency +200ms vs baseline -> rollback to tag `v2026-03-10`. Also watch for mixed-cache headers with new assets.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: tag frontend/4021-canary deployed to canary slot. Monitoring: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/console-deploys

sam: Invalidation submitted: ID 9a7f3c. Purge ETA ~<1m. Will post when purge completes and start pre-warm.

rachel: Can you post the smoke checklist? I'll run: login, open dashboard, run sample query, open settings, save settings, and check console for JS errors. Will paste logs if I see issues.

alex: Checklist: 1) login 2) dashboard load <1s median 3) search/profile flows 4) settings save/roundtrip 5) no new console errors 6) no mixed asset versions. Feature flag: `enableNewAssets=true` — confirm it's set in prod UI.

mira: I'll watch SLOs and error rates (frontend-errors, frontend-latency p95). Ping me for anomalies.

sam: Purge done: 9a7f3c completed in ~45s. Starting pre-warm loop now:
```
for i in {1..10}; do curl -s -I https://console.redwood.ai/ | head -n 5; done
```

rachel: Smoke on canary looks good: dashboard loads, search returns expected results, no console errors in first 5m. :thumbsup:

alex: Proceed to 25% in 5m unless objections. @mira any blockers?

mira: No blockers, go ahead. I'll keep eyes on errors and latency.

deploy-bot: Promoting canary -> 25% now. Deployment ID: dpl-8742.

rachel: 25% looks clean. Ran settings save and profile flows. One minor 404 for a missing image (low priority), not related to main JS bundle.

alex: Noted. We'll proceed to 100% in 10m if metrics stay stable. Sam keep CDN primed and watch for cache hits/misses.

sam: Continuing pre-warm for key assets. Will report back once 100% done.

deploy-bot: Promote -> 100% complete. Deployment ID: dpl-8742-100.

rachel: Smoke at 100%: good. No regressions observed. Leaving a short note: replicated unrelated local bug in dev, not blocking.

alex: Thanks all — if any anomalies in next 30m, post here and we can rollback. I'm keeping this thread open until stable, will close after 30m with no issues.
